tweets: Contracts relying on single price feeds risk executing logic based on distorted market data.
Security-critical calculations often fail because they trust an unvalidated or manipulable source.
Exploits targeting these weaknesses distort contract logic by feeding the system inaccurate prices.
Mitigation requires validating inputs and switching to resilient oracle sources rather than single points of failure.
Aggregating multiple price sources creates a buffer against short-lived attempts to manipulate the feed.
Using time-weighted averages over sufficient windows further resists rapid price distortion attacks.
